scope: Incremental review of existing RoPE and RMSNorm/residual IDs; no new graph nodes or performance points

contracts: RoPE frequencies/trig computed under disabled autocast, then cast to inputs_embeds dtype; position embeddings generated once per model forward and passed to all layers.
rotate_half uses first/second feature halves, not even/odd interleaving; q/k multiplication and addition are separate expressions.
q/k are projection outputs viewed then head/token transposed; query and key head counts differ. Generic rotary API accepts broadcast unsqueeze dimension.
Rotated keys enter optional cache update before attention, so early output dtype changes are not automatically a consumer-only optimization.
RMSNorm converts input to FP32, computes square mean and reciprocal square root, normalizes, casts normalized value to original input dtype, then applies weight.
Decoder returns residual+attention, then residual+MLP. Residual output is a true bypass value, not scratch that may be overwritten.
GQA routing depends on mask and head dimension; mask-present paths may repeat KV rather than enable_gqa.
Preserve attention mask, scaling, causal routing and outputs; changing RoPE output layout can change downstream backend behavior even when logical values match.
Narrow proposed RoPE kernel does not replace SDPA, alter precision before its original boundary, or import a hub attention kernel.
Nonempty MatMul4Bit stores quantization state and packed B, not activation A; backward dequantizes B for grad_A.
Do not assume normalized output is already retained by frozen base matmul when proposing a saved-state swap. Real autograd lifetimes must be measured.
Vanilla q/v LoRA preserves base call and clone, then independent dropout/A/B/scale/add; early norm or q dtype changes affect more than a single cast.
Do not substitute a different saved input or shared dropout branch while optimizing RoPE/norm.

known_pending_proof: Source-derived expected Soup FP32 norm/q/k/cos/sin boundaries still require actual T4 prepared-model inspection.
Residual backward association can be affected by autograd InputBuffer accumulation order; mathematical sum does not prove bitwise fusion equivalence.
Count unique retained storage rather than saved Tensor references; CPU saved-state inventory is not GPU peak-memory measurement.
FMA contraction and early half conversion are not assumed lossless; preserve separate-rounding baseline first.
All existing 121 IDs remain; category mappings unchanged; no experimental coordinate points created.
